page.overview:
Who is Alnaëm?

Alnaëm ("The Sleeper") was a man sent to Arrakis to locate the Fremen.

He was sent to Arrakis to seek the Fremen. Expecting the villains described by Padishah Emperor Shaddam Corrino IV and the Communinet Radio, he was surprised to discover that they were a noble people being drawn into a conspiracy not of their making. Using his Mentat faculties, he discovered signs of the Bene Gesserit and the Missionaria Protectiva seeded amongst the Fremen. He earned their trust and they named him "Alnaëm", a Chakobsa word meaning "The Sleeper". They came to see him as the Lisan al-Gaib and he felt obligated to unite them to achieve the dream of Liet-Kynes. He resolved to drink the Water of Life and become their Mahdi. He suspected that he had been sent to find a particular Fremen and believed the answers he was seeking were beneath Old Carthag. He recorded a solido message at Sietch Ta'lab while being pursued by the Sardaukar, in which he revealed that he had hidden the details of his journey on a minimic film locked in a nearby safe. He ended the recording to lead the Sardaukar away.

Zantara was sent by Stilgar to find Alnaëm after his disappearance. Alnaëm's first recording was found by Ariste Atreides and the Prisoner in Sietch Ta'lab. Learning from the recording that he had hidden another in a nearby safe, they located it. They later met with Zantara in The Salusan Bull, where they used an Ixian decoder to access it and learn the coordinates of where the answers he was seeking could be found.
